common_cover.fact: For a hypothetical integral carrier N, Y is the normalization of the Beauville pullback and simultaneously the normalization of N x_{X4} C0 through either factor.
common_cover.therefore: The Q602 correspondence data start from an underlying O210 carrier N; Y is a decoration of that same carrier.

bolza_correspondence.fact: For the fixed O210 correspondence, T=(f1)_*(f2)^* is built from f1,f2:Y->C0 with degrees 105 and 81.
bolza_correspondence.therefore: T is attached to the same Y arising from the underlying O210 carrier.

q602_operator_filters.fact: The retained Q602 tests are pointwise predicates on the mod-2 residue of that T, first reducing 28 to 16 and then by actual-correspondence Weierstrass parity reducing 16 to [73,97,235].
q602_operator_filters.therefore: A geometrically admissible Q602 configuration is an O210 carrier/cover plus extra correspondence/residue data, not an independent population.
